item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud gu ru'i thugs rgyud las yi dam gu ru drag po'i dbang chog bdud rtsi 'khyil pa
item.coloph: dbal phur gsang ba'i dbang chen bdud rtsi 'khyil ba 'di/ mkha' 'gro mas 'phags btsun pad ma rje'i snyan du brgyud/phyi rabs don du slob dpon gtsug phud tshul khrims kyi bkas bskul ba'i ngor mdangs dar nyi ma'i gling du spel ba dge legs 'phel 'gyur cig/
